boxes.text: Why Gate/Up Interleave = 8: the WGMMA Register Layout
· M: each warp owns 16 rows; each thread holds rows r
· N: registers advance in 8-column groups (4 regs per
· non-swapAB (along N): gate in regs 8k..8k+3, paired
swapAB (along M): row r = gate, row r+8 = up → regs
ltiple of 8 → 8 is the only granularity
